what_to_detect: A creature the resolution neither damaged nor shrank dies in a repeated state-based check, because a permanent that died in an earlier check of the same loop was raising its toughness above the damage marked on it.
near_miss: A creature whose toughness drops in the repeated check stays on the battlefield because the damage marked on it is still below its new toughness.
record_fields: payload.effect zone_change attributed unresolved (gen-3: every death of the state-based loop)

what_to_detect: A player whose draws in a resolution ask for more cards than the library holds loses the game in the state-based check after the resolution.
near_miss: A player whose draws in a resolution leave the library empty or larger, with no draw asked of an empty library, stays in the game.
record_fields: effect half card_drawn events and their count
state.players library size before the resolution

player_won is filed in a record of its own after the resolution (BusBracketCollector.flushOrphanedEvents), and player_lost only on a GameLoss rewrite record, so the loss must be read off the board as sba_game_loss reads life and poison

what_to_detect: A permanent with both +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters loses one of each, in pairs, in the state-based check after a resolution.
near_miss: A permanent with only one kind of those counters keeps them.

what_to_detect: A permanent holding more counters of a kind than its stated maximum has the excess removed in the state-based check.
near_miss: A permanent at or below the maximum keeps its counters.

what_to_detect: A Saga with lore counters at least its final chapter, with no chapter ability on the stack, is sacrificed to its owner's graveyard in the state-based check.
near_miss: A Saga below its final chapter stays on the battlefield.

what_to_detect: All but the most recent Role of one controller on one permanent move to the graveyard in the state-based check.
near_miss: Roles on different permanents, or of different controllers, all stay on the battlefield.

what_to_detect: A leaves-the-battlefield trigger whose condition reads the permanent's counters or characteristics is evaluated against a state-based death, and fires or not by the permanent's last known information from before the whole check.
near_miss: The same trigger is evaluated against such a death and does not fire, because the last known information fails its condition.
record_fields: trigger record payload.fired and event subjects

trigger_mode with keyword (Undying, Persist) or mode ChangesZone matches every evaluation of such a trigger; no parameter restricts it to a death in a check that performed other state-based actions at once (counters annihilating, 704.5q)

what_to_detect: A battle its controller cannot protect has the other player as protector, so it is inside the legal defenders of its controller's attackers.
near_miss: A battle whose protector is the attacking player is outside the legal defenders of that player's attackers.
